description: This file contains test functions for the 'agentfield.multimodal' module, specifically testing functions 'image_from_file', 'audio_from_file', and 'file_from_path' using pytest framework. It creates temporary files for images, audio, and text to verify correct behavior of these functions.

methods.name: test_image_from_file_and_audio_from_file(tmp_path)
methods.description: Tests the loading of image and audio files from temporary paths, verifying the structure and content of the returned objects.

methods.name: test_file_from_path(tmp_path)
methods.description: Tests the loading of a text file from a temporary path, verifying the file URL format.
